business_summary: Nippo Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial materials and plastic molded product in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Electronics, Mobility, and Medical/Precision Equipment. The Electronics segment offers solid and liquid plastic materials, such as semiconductor sealants, polyimide plastic, heat-radiating plastic, and adhesives; functional films, which include dicing films, die attach films, anistropic conduction films, and temporary fastening tape; wiring board materials, consisting PCB materials, photosensitive dry films, and solder materials; oxygen and moisture free packaging materials; and jigs and tools equipment, such as inspection parts, wafer grinding carriers, vespel polyimide materials, teflon coatings, and various metal surface treatments. This segment also offers foamed thermal insulation for piping, plastic three-way valves, and joints, insulating materials, ion-exchange resins, assembled units, IC cards and tags, and radio frequency identification devices. The Medical/Precision Equipment segment offers disposable products, such as waste fluid bag and drug administration units; medical device components, including machined metal parts, processed plastic parts, surface treatments, cast and 3D formed products, and medical robot parts; printers and multifunction machines, consisting of molded plastic parts covers, gears, levers, and coatings, separator claws, stamped metal components, and precision components for printers, wristwatches, and instant cameras. The Mobility segment offers power train components, body system components, electrical system components, aluminum casting, machined metal parts, processed plastic parts, and surface treatments. It also operates contracted design, products for trucks, and products for plastic models. Nippo Ltd. was founded in 1940 and is based in Nagoya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nippo Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본 및 해외에서 산업 자재 및 플라스틱 성형 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 전자, 모빌리티, 의료/정밀 장비의 세 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 전자 부문에서는 반도체 밀봉재, 폴리이미드 플라스틱, 방열 플라스틱, 접착제 등 고체 및 액체 플라스틱 소재를 제공합니다. 다이싱 필름, 다이 어태치 필름, 이방성 전도 필름, 임시 고정 테이프 등의 기능성 필름; PCB 재료, 감광성 드라이 필름 및 납땜 재료로 구성된 배선 기판 재료; 산소와 습기가 없는 포장재; 검사부품, 웨이퍼 연삭 캐리어, 베스펠 폴리이미드 소재, 테프론 코팅, 각종 금속 표면 처리 등의 지그 및 공구 장비 등을 포함합니다. 이 부문은 또한 배관용 발포 단열재, 플라스틱 3방향 밸브 및 조인트, 절연재, 이온 교환 수지, 조립 장치, IC 카드 및 태그, 무선 주파수 식별 장치를 제공합니다. 의료/정밀 장비 부문은 폐액 백 및 약물 투여 장치와 같은 일회용 제품을 제공합니다. 의료기기 콤프
